title: LAUREN V - Mangusta 105
highlights: Mangusta 105 refitted in 2022/23, black and silver-grey palette
Alfresco dining for up to 12 guests
Toys: Seadoo Spark jet ski, Seabob, 3 paddleboards, towing tube, wakeboard, snorkelling gear
description:
LAUREN V is a 31.5-metre Mangusta 105 available for charter in the South of France, with a comprehensive refit in 2022/2023. The owner transformed both the interior and exterior in a sophisticated palette of black and silver grey, striking a balance between sportiness and elegance.

She accommodates up to 9 guests in 4 cabins: a master suite, a VIP cabin and two twin cabins, one with a Pullman bed, looked after by a crew of 4. The impressive aft deck seats up to 12 for alfresco dining, and an excellent chef prepares meals to your preferences.

Twin MTU 1,600 hp engines give a cruising speed of 20 knots and a top speed of 25 knots. Toys include a Williams 325 jet tender, a Seadoo Spark jet ski, a Seabob, 3 paddleboards, a towing tube, a wakeboard and snorkelling equipment.

Available for weekly or daily charter. Contact Yacht Research for availability.
